lab.title: Wazuh Docker Monitoring Lab
lab.courseNote: System monitoring and security management — Docker Wazuh single-node deployment with three reporting agents.

architecture.label: Hosting laptop
architecture.detail: Endpoint visibility for the primary workstation

architecture.label: Lab VM
architecture.detail: Docker single-node stack (manager, indexer, dashboard) plus local agent

architecture.label: VPN server
architecture.detail: Remote VPN host reporting back to the manager

steps.title: Setup and installation
steps.summary: Deploy Wazuh as a Docker single-node stack on the lab VM, including the host sysctl prerequisite.
actions: Choose Docker single-node installation on an existing VM
Clone the official Wazuh Docker single-node deployment
Run sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144 on the host so the indexer can start
Bring up the Wazuh manager, indexer, and dashboard containers

steps.title: Configuration for monitoring
steps.summary: Install and point three Wazuh agents at the manager, then confirm they are all connected.
actions: Configure the Wazuh agent on the hosting laptop to reach the manager on the VM
Install and configure the Wazuh agent on the VM itself
Configure the Wazuh agent on the VPN server from the previous assignment
Verify all three agents are reporting correctly in the Wazuh manager
